summary: Backend-only testing of Phase 1 JWT security hardening. 16/16 tests pass (1 skipped as Phase 3 expected gap). Verified: login returns real JWT (starts with 'eyJ', not 'mock_token_'), JWT has correct sub/role/exp fields, JWT signature verifiable with JWT_SECRET, all 4 backdoor endpoints return 410 Gone, Bearer JWT accepted by RBAC endpoints, verify_jwt_token() works correctly for valid/invalid/tampered/legacy mock_token/empty inputs.
critical_code_review_comments: Phase 3 gap (expected): most data endpoints (contacts, campaigns, etc.) still accept requests via path-parameter user_id WITHOUT JWT auth check. /api/admin/users returns 200 even with invalid JWT (no X-User-ID fallback either). Per agent context this is known and intentional for Phase 3.
reset_codes dict is in-memory (line 99 auth.py) — will be lost on restart. Known limitation, not introduced by this change.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 JWT security is fully working. Login issues real HS256 JWT signed with JWT_SECRET. Backdoor endpoints (admin-reset, admin-fix-login, force-reset-password, admin-fix-all-passwords) all return 410. verify_jwt_token() correctly handles valid/invalid/tampered/legacy/empty tokens. Legacy mock_token_<id> accepted with _legacy=True flag. RBAC Bearer path works. Phase 3 (enforcing JWT on all data endpoints) is not yet implemented — that is expected.
